ABOUT US

We’re serving a complete, high-quality southern experience for those who want accessible, and upscale breakfast, brunch, and lunch dining. Completely sophisticated yet totally casual, our menu features hearty breakfast and lunch fare paired with deliciously unique cocktails and built-to-order bloody marys.

Whether you want a meal and music, or just a place to enjoy a cup of coffee, you’ll find what you’re looking for here at Brick & Spoon™️. We’re your much-needed neighborhood stop for breakfast, brunch, and lunch—whether you’re on a liquid diet or no diet at all!

Our owners founded Brick & Spoon™️ because they wanted to spread the southern mojo across the country. Good food, good drinks, good entertainment all get together at Brick & Spoon™️ every day. You and your friends and family should too!

A DESTINATION FOR CASUAL BREAKFAST, BRUNCH, DINING, AND COFFEE

The Brick & Spoon™ concept was built upon the success stories of New Orleans style casual breakfast/brunch dining and coffee house venues. Brick & Spoon provides accessible and affordable high quality food, beverages, and entertainment to the residents and tourists located in your designated market area. Once your franchise is up and running, Brick & Spoon will quickly establish itself as a “destination” of choice to the many residents of the area, as well as numerous out-of-town visitors.

SOUTHERN BRICK LOVERS REJOICE!

We pride ourselves on being a Southern-based and inspired restaurant! We wanted a name that was unique to us, but also pointed to our heritage that we are so very proud to have influence our lives. The brick refers to the rustic southern setting that is so dear to our hearts and has helped to shape and mold our lives and our food. The spoon refers to the utensil most commonly associated with breakfast and brunch. We are bringing a new, unique, and incredibly delicious menu to the table! As the owners and founders of Brick & Spoon, we are proud to be born and raised in South Louisiana and we are using this opportunity to spread our culinary traditions as well as our hospitality!

COMMUNITY INVOLVEMENT

Finally, and quite significantly, Brick & Spoon™ will provide a muchneeded neighborhood-based breakfast/brunch food operation that is currently scarcely available to residents and visitors alike. Not only is it projected that the business will generate great sales margins, but Brick & Spoon will also supply the community with a number of new jobs.

QUALITATIVE REQUIREMENTS
QUALIFICATIONS FOR FRANCHISE OWNERS:

• Strong Sales and Client Service Abilities • Good with Timing and Schedule Management • High Personal Standards • Able to Meet Initial Investment Requirements • Strong Sense of Integrity in Corporate and Client Relationships • A Willingness and Commitment to Excellent Service

TYPICAL FRANCHISEES

• Franchise Operations Experience • Business Owner and/or Managerial Experience • Husband and Wife entrepreneurial team who want to start a business

KEYS TO SUCCESS

Brick & Spoon is committed to providing an outstanding restaurant experience to our customers. It is our goal to exceed our customers’ expectations for quality and service, while paying close attention to our customer’s individual needs. The keys to success in a Brick and Spoon franchise are

PRODUCT QUALITY

Breakfast, beverages, and entertainment are our products. They must be of the highest quality and value.

SERVICE

Brick & Spoon patrons are paying to have a good time. Their experience will suffer if service is not of the highest caliber. Each member of the staff will be courteous, efficient, and attentive

MARKETING

Targeting your audience early and often is essential to your success. While the business is located in a central and accessible location, many people will have to be introduced to the Brick & Spoon concept.

MANAGEMENT

Franchisee’s will need to have a firm grasp on food, beverage, and labor costs. The dining/bar/ entertainment experience must be delivered in a fashion that will not only inspire repeat business, but also encourage word-of-mouth recommendations to others. Proper inventory, employee management, and quality control are key.

... BRICK BY BRICK
WE’RE HERE TO HELP YOU BUILD GREAT & PROFITABLE FRANCHISE LOCATIONS

We’ve got all the tools and knowledge you need to launch your franchise from the ground-up. We’ve successfully launched Brick & Spoon restaurants in some of the most competitive, and cut-throat food and service industry markets in the country. We’ve taken our licks and had our successes, thus making launching your very own Brick & Spoon the easy part!

FRANCHISE SUPPORT INCLUDES

• Accounting & Legal Support • In-Depth Training • Assistance on Site Selection • Floor Plan & Store Design • Equipment Program • Grand-Opening Support & Assistance • Telephone Support • Management Updates • On-Going Research and Development • Advertising, Marketing, Branding, PR Support • Dynamic P.O.S. System • Overall Program Oversight

OPERATIONS HANDBOOK

An operations handbook and manual is provided to all franchisees. It contains in-depth instructions on the following:

Pre-Store Build-Out • Opening Procedures • Equipment Program • Ordering Goods • Equipment Source & Operation • General Operating Instructions • Employee Handbook • Best Service Practices

MARKETING TOOLS

From building and implementing an effective promotional strategy to social media practices, to printed designed Take-Out cups, Brick & Spoon is backed by a full service marketing team that makes sure each Brick & Spoon franchise is built to achieve great success in their target markets.

MEDIA LIBRARY

In-Store displays, banners and other ad design materials are readily available for franchisees. Additionally, video and radio content is also available for franchisee media placement.

HOW CAN I OPEN A BRICK & SPOON FRANCHISE?

Brick & Spoon actively seeks qualified individuals to become franchisees. Prior business experience, coupled with personal financial qualifications, individual motivation and success record are important factors in our evaluation process. If you are interested in pursuing single unit or area development opportunities as a Brick & Spoon franchisee, please call our corporate headquarters at 337-456-3269 and a franchise builder will contact you to discuss.

HOW MUCH MONEY DO I NEED TO OPEN A FRANCHISE?

Individuals will need $250,000 in non-borrowed personal resources along with an overall net worth (total assets minus total liabilities) of $1,000,000 to qualify. Financing is to be secured through thirdparty lending sources. The total cost of each restaurant varies by size and location.

HOW LONG DOES IT TAKE TO OPEN A BRICK & SPOON RESTAURANT?

Each location is different, depending on a variety of factors. However, it typically takes approximately 6-8 months from signing the franchise agreement to opening day at your Brick & Spoon restaurant.

WHAT KIND OF RESULTS CAN I EXPECT AFTER OPENING MY LOCATION?

While we can’t guarantee your franchise will rule the breakfast and brunch world in your market, we can tell you our current locations all have been tremendous commercial and critical successes

DO I HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO OWN A BRICK & SPOON?

We’re looking for ambitious, and dedicated individuals (see qualitative requirements). With the proper mindset, owning a Brick & Spoon Franchise can be both altruistic as well as financially rewarding.
